Record Class CachedAstMetadata

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.nb.tools.project.components.CachedAstMetadata
Record Components:
lastModified - The filesystem modification timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) when this file was parsed.
kind - The primary Java element kind of the top-level type (e.g. ElementKind.CLASS).
supertypes - Formatted supertypes string (e.g. "extends DesktopAgiTool implements Callable"), or null.
javadocSummary - Sanitized first sentence of class-level Javadoc summary, or null.
innerClasses - Recursive descriptors for all inner, nested, and anonymous types declared in this file.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public record CachedAstMetadata(long lastModified, ElementKind kind, String supertypes, String javadocSummary, List<CachedInnerClass> innerClasses) extends Record implements Serializable
High-performance, in-memory cache for resolved AST metadata of Java source files.

Binds resolved compiler metadata (element kinds, supertypes, Javadoc summaries, and recursive inner class structures) to a FileObject's path and its lastModified filesystem timestamp. This prevents re-running the heavy Javac compiler pipeline (JavaSource.toPhase(Phase.ELEMENTS_RESOLVED)) on unchanged files on subsequent conversation turns, dropping warm-turn structure scans to sub-millisecond speeds.

Author:
Anahata
